  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Discuss the methods to specify an algorithm by highlighting the differences between an  
  algorithm and program.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Elaborate and explain the algorithm used for time complexity.                                 (3)  
  C)      Discuss the significance of a transpose matrix in data structures.                            (3)  
  2)           Illustrate the conversion of Infix to Postfix operation by taking any arithmetic  
  expression.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Differentiate between Stacks and Queues.                                                      (3)  
  C)      With an example code, explain the insertion operation at the end for a Singly linked list. (3)  
  
  3)           Illustrate and explain the methods for deletion of a node in case of a Binary Search tree.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Enlist tree traversal operations and explain any one with suitable example.                   (3)  
  C)      Elaborate the terminologies used in AVL tree with proper definitions.                         (3)  
  4)           With an illustration, explain the adjacency list to represent graphs.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Suggest an algorithm for Linear search considering both Best case and Worst case  
  complexities.                                                                                 (3)  
  
  C)      Discuss the steps of Merge sort algorithm.                                                    (3)  
  5)           Suggest an algorithm for Merge sort highlighting the significance of the same.                (4)
